scope: Nine static functional/creature identity states. No animation or runtime integration claim.

frames.description: Compact warm receiving body and bent condenser with a small attached receiving vessel.
frames.actualUse: Owned AlchemyStillPart provides immediate real brewing interaction; existing non-solid furniture.
frames.limits: No flame, bubbles, liquid level, output item or invented ready/running state.

frames.description: Two broad empty compartments between upright wooden posts and low feet.
frames.actualUse: Existing solid wooden Container owner. Empty native compartments do not manufacture stock.
frames.limits: No bottle silhouettes, herbs, painted supplies, loot count or new open/closed state.

frames.description: Three ochre hooked burr heads over dark leathery leaves on irregular stems.
frames.actualUse: Unspent HarvestablePart yields StoneburrSeed and removes the source after successful gathering.
frames.limits: Burrs identify the source, not yield count. No corn-like kernels, ripe crop flag or permanent spent plant.

frames.description: Low broken cold mineral crust with broad, quiet lobes close to the ground.
frames.actualUse: Unspent HarvestablePart yields FrostLichen and removes this source on success.
frames.limits: Not a flowering plant, pool, emitted frost cloud, ready coating or safe drink.

frames.description: Three broad pointed soft leaves, each with a simple pale central vein.
frames.actualUse: Unspent HarvestablePart yields MendleafSprig and removes this source on success.
frames.limits: No new flower, glow, crop growth state, harvest count or baked effect.

frames.description: Compact cream-breasted dark bird with a low long tail, angular head, short beak and two separated feet.
frames.actualUse: Actual passive hoarder creature; inventory and pickup events remain simulation-owned.
frames.limits: No permanent stolen item, sack, toy eyes, wing animation or directional sheet claim.

frames.description: Low angular S-shaped snake with a broad raised head, narrow neck and open lower coil.
frames.actualUse: Actual hostile creature with ViperBite; poison and corpse/gland outcomes remain simulation state.
frames.limits: No permanent poison, tongue flick, invented limbs or new directional motion.

frames.description: Forward-leaning shale-backed Gleaner anatomy, repaired pale straps and one small accessible healing bottle in its cradle.
frames.actualUse: Actual owned FieldMedicinePart.FindCarriedMedicine() returns a positive carried healing tonic.
frames.limits: Healing slot only, not total medicine count; hands remain equipment-neutral. Static pose.

frames.description: The identical shale body and repaired straps, with the small healing cradle exposed.
frames.actualUse: Actual owned medicine query finds no carried healing tonic. Separate Antidote may remain.
frames.limits: Not an all-medicine-empty claim; no changed stance, missing equipment, injury or weakened behavior implied.
